first_entry.name: Log Started
first_entry.unlock: First log secured. Someone should know you were here.

first_checkin.name: First Task Secured
first_checkin.description: Secure a survival task for the first time.
first_checkin.unlock: First task secured. Day one is going better than most.

streak_3.name: Three Days Alive
streak_3.description: Survive 3 days in a row on any survival task.
streak_3.unlock: Three days survived. Statistically, you are doing brilliantly.

streak_7.name: One Week Survivor
streak_7.description: Survive 7 days in a row on any survival task.
streak_7.unlock: A full week. The cockroaches are starting to respect you.

streak_14.name: Fortnight Holdout
streak_14.description: Survive 14 days in a row on any survival task.
streak_14.unlock: Two weeks survived. You have outlasted the tinned peaches.

streak_30.name: Seasoned Scavenger
streak_30.description: Survive 30 days in a row on any survival task.
streak_30.unlock: Thirty days. You have a reputation now, mostly for not dying.

streak_60.name: Hardened Survivor
streak_60.description: Survive 60 days in a row on any survival task.
streak_60.unlock: Sixty days. Other survivors are starting to ask you for advice.

streak_100.name: Last One Standing
streak_100.description: Survive 100 days in a row on any survival task.
streak_100.unlock: One hundred days survived. Honestly, the rest of us are a bit jealous.

entries_7.name: Survivor's Diary
entries_7.description: Write a survival log on 7 different days.
entries_7.unlock: Seven logs written. If the worst happens, there is a record.

entries_30.name: Chronicler of the End
entries_30.description: Write a survival log on 30 different days.
entries_30.unlock: Thirty logs. Future archaeologists will have plenty to work with.

entries_100.name: Last Archivist
entries_100.description: Write a survival log on 100 different days.
entries_100.unlock: One hundred logs. Whoever finds these will need a very large shelf.

prompts_10.name: Radio Regular
prompts_10.unlock: Ten radio questions answered. Someone out there is listening.

prompts_50.name: Voice on the Airwaves
prompts_50.unlock: Fifty answered. You are basically a broadcaster now. Nobody is complaining.

habits_3.name: Three Fronts Held
habits_3.description: Hold a 7-day streak on three survival tasks at once.
habits_3.unlock: Three tasks, seven days, no incidents. Suspiciously competent.
